name: piserver-statusbar
description: Live status indicator for up to 3 simultaneous PiServer heads in the VS Code statusbar.

piserver-led.description: LED circle (color set at runtime via StatusBarItem.color)

piserver.scriptPath.description: Absolute path to piserver.py — explicit per-machine override. Leave empty to use the "path-to-server" key in the project's pi-config.json instead, or to auto-detect piserver.py at the workspace root if neither is set. Auto-filled by the Start button's self-heal search when all of the above miss.

piserver.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to launch piserver.py — explicit per-machine override. Leave empty to use the "path-to-python" key in pi-config.json, or plain "python" on PATH if neither is set.

piserver.searchRoots.description: Extra folders to search for piserver.py when the Start button can't find it any other way. Leave empty to search your user folder only.

piserver.pythonRunningColor.description: Color of the Python LED while running. Defaults to the official Python.org brand blue, not the conventional status green — override this if you'd prefer a standard color.

piserver.serverRunningColor.description: Color of the HTTP server LED while running. Defaults to the official Python.org brand yellow, not the conventional status green — override this if you'd prefer a standard color.

piserver.offlineColor.description: Color of both LEDs when the server is offline.

piserver.displayBackgroundColor.description: Background of the LCD display while running. VSCode only allows extensions to use one of its four built-in status bar background colors here (no arbitrary custom color, e.g. black, is possible through the API) — 'default' leaves it unset.

piserver.displayFontColor.description: Text color of the LCD display while running. Lime by default.
